pageTitle: hub by Premier Inn | London Westminster Abbey Hotel
pageDescription: Stay in style at our hub by Premier Inn London Westminster Abbey hotel. We're next to Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace and St James's Park.
hotelDescription:
Westminster is buzzing with stories to tell - from the Gothic grandeur of Westminster Abbey to the dazzling Buckingham Palace. Here it’s all at your feet, from the city’s most famous landmarks to slick drinking dens and some gloriously green spaces.

From convenient touchscreen controls that let you control your room’s lighting and temperature, to inviting double beds and high-spec en-suite bathrooms, sleek pull-out desks and plenty of under-bed storage, our stylish, compact rooms are cleverly designed around you. Catch up with friends online or watch the latest blockbuster movies through your 40" smart TV. Stay connected with super-fast, free Wi-Fi*, and experience the city at your fingertips. 

There’s a choice of two room types at this hub hotel – Standard and Bigger.
hotelDirections: Our closest tube station is St James's Park on the District and Circle line. Use the Park and Broadway exit where Broadway meets Tothill Street. Continue along Tothill Street, passing Costa Pronto on the corner along the way. The hotel will be on your right.
parkingDescription: hub by Premier Inn does not have a car park. We're so central we would encourage you to leave your car at home and arrive by public transport.

donations.title: Support the Disasters Emergency Committee and the humanitarian effort in Ukraine
donations.info: We’ve all seen the humanitarian crisis affecting the people of the Ukraine. Our hearts are with all those whose lives have been affected by these devastating events, and the unimaginable suffering caused by this needless human tragedy. 100% of your donation will go to The Disasters Emergency Committee (DEC) in support of their international humanitarian aid effort. It's the task of this charity to supply food, water, first aid, medicine, warm clothes, and shelter for refugees, which is why any support you can offer today will be invaluable in helping the people of Ukraine.*

restaurant.name: Lounge
restaurant.description: Start your day with breakfast including fresh toast, pastries, fruit, yoghurt and porridge, plus unlimited tea, coffee and orange juice. Just ask to add breakfast to your stay at reception. Later, tuck into our tasty deli boards or range of sandwiches, soups, salads and home comfort dishes. In the evening, join us for a tipple or two during our cocktail Happy Hour. From 5pm-8pm, buy any drink from our menu and enjoy a complimentary cheese plate on us.*

menus.name: Breakfast
menus.description: Start your day right with a mix of continental breakfast items and a selection of hot cooked food. From sausage, scrambled egg and bacon to fresh pastries, toast, fruit salad, yoghurts and porridge, just tuck in. Plus there’s unlimited coffee, Twinings tea and orange juice, too.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

menus.name: Dinner
menus.description: Grab a bite to eat and tuck into favourites like nachos with chilli con carne, margherita pizza or a delicious chicken makhani curry. Some of our dishes are also available for you to take away and enjoy in your room.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

announcement.text: Get all the latest updates on our response to COVID-19 and see how we’re keeping guests safe with our Premier Inn CleanProtectTM promise.
